_doc: Case Packs (gen/imposter_gen.py --packs). Each pack has `cases` cases of 6 rounds; themes rotate like a season. Pools are pack-<id>-<key>. Only packs whose cases are all generated and approved (--pack-approve) are built into the site. `free` is shown in the UI; the server limit is FREE_PACK_CASES in lib/packs.js.

packs.name: Wildlife
packs.tagline: 30 cases from the field. One creature in every lineup was never born.
